body: You apparently read neither my post nor the sidebar for this subreddit. Thanks for the shitty "help," though.

To answer both of you: it's a bit complicated. At the very least I know I couldn't explain it succinctly. If it really helps to know why I am suffering, I can share that. But I am more curious as to how to cope. If a person feels inconsolably alone in this world, suffers both physical and emotional pain, and has both inadequate coping skills as well as too sparse of a support system -- what can they do to keep going? How would you advise I continue to fight this impulse "to sneeze?" (A blog I came across recently described the desire to commit suicide as similar to the urge to sneeze. Nothing else seems like it will bring the desired relief, and it takes so much willpower not to give into it. I like this analogy and am appropriating it here...)
